sources.quote: K2-155d is a potentially habitable Super-Earth exoplanet in the K2-155 system.

introduction.text: It is one of 3 planets known around K2-155. Its orbit and size follow Díez Alonso et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.

sources.quote: It is the outermost of three known planets orbiting around the K-type star K2-155 in the constellation Taurus, approximately 290 light-years from Earth.
